purpose: Bounded 32-row admission preflight: two scenarios x four Water physical families x configured workers 1/4 x Windows/Linux, 30 completed native ticks, before any seven-scenario expansion.

lane_notes.A: Matched execution geometry: every family at explicit radius 3. Physical-behaviour lane.
lane_notes.B: Preferred geometry: non-IN families at their native radius 2. InertialCellular's preferred geometry is radius 3, identical to its lane-A row, which is therefore not re-executed. Timings of lanes A and B are never pooled.

invariants: requested Water family/variant/radius/workers equal native applied readback; every non-Water assignment equals the native default
normalization receipt net/positive/negative deltas equal the registered values
complete stored Water quantity (visible plus pressure overfill) equals the registered initial quantity after every completed tick
complete 1024x1024 inventory contains only registered materials; Wall changes only by the registered tick-zero edit
no World failure, tick failure count zero, completed ticks equal the horizon
inertial arms: complete motion census, zero negative vertical velocity
configured 1 and 4 workers of the same arm: identical per-tick physical hashes and identical terminal Water, inventory, inertial digest and pressure ledger
World retired after the run: no reference remains and the process exits 0
stop_conditions: requested policy not applied or silently replaced
worker-count divergence of the same arm
unsafe retirement or failed World reported healthy
participation_semantics: Configured workers are capacity. worker_threads_observed is the maximum distinct task-claiming participants in one phase dispatch of the completed tick, not utilization or proof of simultaneous overlap.
negative_controls: inertial Water at radius 2 refuses and retains the previous World and receipt
whole-cell Water families refuse a fractional fill without explicit normalization and retain the previous World
explicit normalization of the same fractional fill records its exact nonzero deltas
pressure variants are refused for Oil and Brine
cached and cached_dormant variants are not offered for non-pressure families
